verdict.rationale: Bruno exposes a CLI and a scripting `bru` API plus regular GitHub releases, but the evidence pack contains no documentation of API versioning guarantees or a formal deprecation policy for any of these surfaces. Probe for an OpenAPI/spec endpoint also returned 404s, further indicating no formal versioned API contract is published. missing for 10: documented API/CLI versioning scheme, explicit deprecation policy, evidence of backward-compatibility guarantees.
